style: One 3:2 simple friendly classroom cartoon illustration per scene, dark outlines, soft colors, no text or watermark.
scenes: A narrow floating island of grass, rocks and a few trees surrounded by fluffy clouds and empty blue sky. A friendly lion with orange mane, a brown bear and a small tan dog stand on the island. Far above on a cloud stands Arthur, a young adult sky god with short dark hair, simple blue tunic and small golden flame glowing on his chest.

Arthur, young adult with short dark hair wearing a simple blue tunic with no glowing flame, rests in a small branch-and-leaf shelter on a grassy floating island among clouds. Friendly brown bear adds branches to roof, lion with orange mane brings fruit in mouth, small tan dog sits protectively beside Arthur. Warm caring scene.

Arthur, young adult with short dark hair in a simple blue tunic with no flame, crosses a wooden branch bridge over a gap in a rocky floating island among clouds. Friendly brown bear holds branch steady, lion with orange mane leads, small tan dog sniffs trail. All four full bodies visible, safe adventurous mood.

Arthur, young adult with short dark hair wearing simple blue tunic, takes one bite from a glowing golden apple beneath a small magical golden-fruit tree. Golden light gently returns to his chest and hands. Friendly lion with orange mane, brown bear and small tan dog watch beside him. Floating island among clouds.

Arthur, young adult sky god with short dark hair and simple blue tunic, kneels with glowing golden hands against the ground. A fresh green world spreads in front of him with hills, mountains, rivers and trees. Lion with orange mane, brown bear and tan dog watch. Clouds high above, welcoming wide landscape.

Arthur, young adult sky god with short dark hair and simple blue tunic, introduces his teenage son with short dark hair and simple green tunic to a friendly lion with orange mane, brown bear and small tan dog. They stand beside a river on the new green Earth, trees and hills behind them. Son has no magic, Arthur's hands have a faint gold glow.
